description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency models. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 33, with tick labels at intervals of 1. 

The line representing “Consistency-CE” is purple, uses circular markers, and is dashed; it begins at approximately (2.5, 26.2) and ends at approximately (10.0, 31.5), showing a generally increasing trend. The line representing “Inconsistency-CE” is dark blue, uses square markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (2.5, 26.0) and ends at approximately (10.0, 31.4), also showing a generally increasing trend. The line representing “Inconsistency-CE-MP” is light blue, uses square markers, and is dashed; it begins at approximately (2.5, 26.3) and ends at approximately (10.0, 32.1), with a generally increasing trend. Finally, the line representing “Consistency-Bi” is red, uses star markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (2.5, 29.3) and ends at approximately (10.0, 32.4), also showing a generally increasing trend.
